svg.title: Remote workplace (v1.3): the remote harness attaches by SSH into its own OS user on our host; tool calls run inside that boundary; tasks arrive through the mailbox; no commands flow towards the remote machine

g.text: Remote workplace (v1.3): the remote harness attaches by SSH into its own OS user on our host; tool calls run inside that boundary; tasks arrive through the mailbox; no commands flow towards the remote machine
ssh ext_k@host, key K (pinned in authorized_keys);
host key fingerprint checked against the credential package
session as uid ext_k; forced command: rwh tool runner
(firewall: only broker + egress proxy; no other egress)
tool channel open (framed over the SSH session)
Only tool execution crosses this channel.
Our side never opens a connection to the
remote machine and never sends commands into it.
snapshot of the task for K (projection of one element)
signed message to K: "task X, snapshot ref" (grant: session.input? no — post to K's mailbox)
verify signature, grant, decision guard; mailbox record
mailbox read (through its tool, over the carrier) → body + verification record
agent loop decides to take the task
tool call (bash, git, files) over the SSH channel
execute as ext_k; egress only through the profile proxy
post result (signed by K); audience projection → thread
delete user ext_k, remove firewall rules;
K's identity stays pinned unless revoked
